seo.title: Thank you: consultation request received
seo.description: Your request for a consultation with Calwebtech has arrived. Here is how the call will be arranged and what we prepare.

title: Thanks. Your consultation request is with us.
intro: We have your details and the context you gave for the call. A confirmation email is on its way to the address you gave.

steps.title: We arrange a time
steps.body: A person replies within one business day with a time for your thirty minute call, in your timezone.

steps.title: We prepare
steps.body: The people who would run your project look at your current site first, so the call is useful rather than exploratory.

steps.title: We tell you what we would do
steps.body: You hear what we would change, roughly what it costs and whether we are the wrong fit. Send your NDA beforehand if you need one.

secondary.heading: Before the call
secondary.body: Read through the five stages of a project so you can ask about the parts that matter most to you.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
